subject: Learning Methods
title: The Protege Effect
description: A quick, practical guide to The Protege Effect.

hook.text: Students responsible for teaching material to a younger student studied harder and remembered more than those studying.

buildup.text: The protege effect describes how expecting to teach activates stronger preparation than expecting to be tested.

discovery.text: When you know someone depends on your explanation, you feel accountable. That accountability drives deeper processing.

twist.text: Even pretend teaching triggers the effect. Simply believing you will teach activates the same preparation intensity.

climax.text: Before any study session, tell yourself you will teach this tomorrow. Your brain automatically prepares more thoroughly.

punchline.text: Study as if you will teach tomorrow. Preparation intensifies.

quiz.question: What drives the protege effect?
options: Expecting to teach activates stronger preparation than expecting to be tested
